what_happened: All seven $0 gates passed, the pod was created and SSH came up in 0.2 min, and setup died one line after ENV_READY: the launcher declared WS=/workspace/aad and REPO=/workspace/aad/repo and put the session status file under a scratch/ subdirectory, while autoinit_preflight_setup.sh declares WS=/workspace and REPO=$WS/aad and nothing creates a subdirectory before its first mark(). The pod was deleted behind the teardown path and the provider confirms it is gone.
what_it_exposed: A second path defect that had not yet fired: the driver wrote its evidence into the workdir while c2_replay_artifacts.json patterns it at audit/autoinit_c2_replay/. That is the session's ONE required artifact, so a torn-down run would have come home with no record of itself -- and on a failure path the evidence is the only thing worth having.
repairs: pod paths read from the setup script rather than invented, with a test that parses WS= and REPO= out of it and refuses a status file in a subdirectory
evidence written to --audit-dir, with a test that reads the artifact spec's pattern and the launcher's driver command and requires them to name the same directory
